notes: three shaykhs are co-transmitters joined by «جميعا عن سفيان»

the dash remark «- قال يحيى أخبرنا سفيان بن عيينة -» names Yahya's own version with a different transmitter at this level: read as a variant group (rule 4), not a route; the rest of its chain is the shared one
the dash remark is a judgement call: an editor's gloss would be left out; I read it as a transmitter's variant because it names another man for the same level
